**Delivery function — path:** `/bench/repo/internal/webhook/webhook.go` (the `Post` function at lines 120-180)

**Protection mechanism — path:** `/bench/repo/internal/webhook/validate.go` (the `safeDialContext` function is defined in `webhook.go` at lines 57-77, which uses the `isReservedIP` function defined in `validate.go` at lines 44-54)

The delivery actually executes in the `Post` function which uses a `safeClient` HTTP client configured with a custom `DialContext` called `safeDialContext`. This protection mechanism checks resolved IP addresses against a list of reserved/private CIDR ranges defined in `validate.go` (lines 14-23, which cover loopback, RFC-1918 private ranges, link-local, and cloud IMDS addresses). The `isReservedIP` function (lines 44-54) determines if an IP falls within any of these reserved ranges and blocks the connection if it does, unless the `AllowPrivateIPs` flag is explicitly enabled for self-hosted deployments.
